stemMd: Equal masses of the same liquid at 20 and 60 degrees Celsius are mixed in an insulated container of negligible heat capacity. Assuming constant equal specific heat and no phase change, what is the final temperature?
explanationMd: Heat lost by the warmer mass equals heat gained by the cooler. Equal masses and specific heats make the final temperature the average, 40 degrees Celsius.

distractorRationale.d: Temperatures are not added to find equilibrium.
distractorRationale.a: Equal heat capacities give equal weighting.
